text.arabic_uthmani: وَرَءَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ ٱلنَّارَ فَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُم مُّوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًۭا

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction that carries the judgment sequence into a new visual scene

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: seeing verb that launches the new visual action

words.prose: The opening {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps 18:53 joined to the judgment scene of 18:52 while launching a new visual frame. Its attachment to {{ar:رَأَى}} ({{tr:ra'ā}}) makes the transition feel like the visible result of the prior placement, not a detached new report.

topics.headline: resumptive visual-scene bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as the visible continuation of the preceding judgment scene, not as a disconnected sentence.
topics.reason: The conjunction is clause-initial and precedes the seeing clause, while attachment evidence makes {{ar:رَأَى}} ({{tr:ra'ā}}) the first action of the new scene.

words.gloss_range: perfect seeing/perceiving verb; local object makes sight concrete while the next clause turns sight into recognition
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes seeing, perceiving, and judging; the local frame selects direct sight with cognitive consequence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: direct object seen by the criminals
plural subject of the seeing verb
result clause that turns sight into recognition

words.prose: {{ar:رَأَى}} ({{tr:ra'ā}}) is a completed act of seeing with {{ar:ٱلنَّارَ}} ({{tr:an-nāra}}) as its direct object, so the first beat is concrete vision. Because the verb stands before the plural subject {{ar:ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ}} ({{tr:al-mujrimūna}}), the group is presented as one collective witness. The root range still matters: seeing the fire immediately becomes recognition through {{ar:فَظَنُّوا}} ({{tr:fa-ẓannū}}), and the scene answers the earlier record scene where the criminals were seen fearful (18:49). The hamza gives the seeing verb a small recited catch, while the variant reading remains texture rather than a different local sense.

topics.headline: completed collective sight of the fire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fire is not inferred; it is the direct visible object encountered by the guilty class as a collective.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make {{ar:ٱلنَّارَ}} ({{tr:an-nāra}}) the explicit direct object of a perfect Form I seeing verb before a plural postverbal subject.

topics.headline: sight becomes recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that physical sight and inward recognition are linked, while the object keeps the local sense from becoming mere opinion.
topics.reason: The concrete object narrows the verb to actual seeing, but the immediate movement to {{ar:فَظَنُّوا}} ({{tr:fa-ẓannū}}) preserves the perception-to-understanding pressure.

topics.headline: seeing returns in judgment echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the criminals move from being seen around the record to seeing the fire themselves (18:49).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL echo rows give the concrete same-surah reference, and no local evidence blocks the judgment-scene recurrence.

topics.headline: phonetic variant without sense replacement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the live recitational texture of the seeing verb without treating the variant as a different local meaning.
topics.reason: The variant preserves the same root and seeing function, so it can register phonetic texture but cannot replace the local parse of {{ar:رَأَى}} ({{tr:ra'ā}}).

words.gloss_range: definite nominative plural active-participle class label naming the agents of seeing, certainty, and failed finding
words.root_gloss_range: root field centers on crime and culpable severance; body, acquisition, and stripping images remain secondary pressure, not the local sense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: seeing verb governed by the named subject
later plural cognition verb carrying the same subject
later plural finding verb carrying the same subject

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ}} ({{tr:al-mujrimūna}}) names the human party after the boundary of 18:52 and anchors the subject chain for {{ar:رَأَى}} ({{tr:ra'ā}}), {{ar:ظَنُّوا}} ({{tr:ẓannū}}), and {{ar:يَجِدُوا}} ({{tr:yajidū}}). Its definiteness makes them a known guilty class rather than an incidental crowd. The root-family pressure keeps that guilt concrete: severance from the normative order, an acquired state, and embodied presences facing the fire, while the local sense remains the criminal class. The same class returns from the record scene (18:49), where they were fearful around the book, into direct vision of the fire here.

topics.headline: explicit subject holds one agent chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one named class remains responsible through seeing, recognition, and failed search.
topics.reason: The noun is the explicit postverbal subject, and later 3mp forms and {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) resume it.

topics.headline: definite plural guilty class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guilt is presented as a recognized judgment category, not an undefined group label.
topics.reason: The article, plural ending, and contextual profile support a known culpable class in narration.

topics.headline: culpability colored by severance and embodiment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moral label carries embodied and severing pressure while remaining the local term for criminals.
topics.reason: The root images can enrich {{ar:ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ}} ({{tr:al-mujrimūna}}), but QAC and context keep the selected local sense as the guilty class.

topics.headline: same class from record scene to fire scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the criminals of the record scene are carried forward into the fire scene (18:49).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide the concrete same-surah reference and the local wording keeps the same epithet active.

words.gloss_range: definite singular fire as the accusative object seen by the criminals and later resumed by feminine pronouns
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes fire and light; the local word selects punitive fire rather than guiding light

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: predicate with suffix referring back to the fire
prepositional phrase with suffix referring back to the fire

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّارَ}} ({{tr:an-nāra}}) is the direct object of sight and the first major landing point of the ayah. Its definiteness makes the announced fire of 18:29 become the fire now seen, while its feminine reference returns through {{ar:مُوَاقِعُوهَا}} ({{tr:muwāqi'ūhā}}) and {{ar:عَنْهَا}} ({{tr:'anhā}}). The light-root background is narrowed locally to destructive illumination: this is exposure and burning, not guidance-light.

topics.headline: the announced fire becomes seen
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a previously announced punishment becomes an immediate visible object (18:29).
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the object of {{ar:رَأَى}} ({{tr:ra'ā}}), and the CRITICAL rows connect its definiteness with 18:29.

topics.headline: destructive light rather than guidance-light
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the luminous root pressure, but in its punitive fire mode rather than as guidance.
topics.reason: The local surface is {{ar:ٱلنَّارَ}} ({{tr:an-nāra}}); root kinship with light is real but narrowed by the judgment scene and concrete fire object.

topics.headline: fire remains present through pronouns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fire disappears as a noun but keeps governing encounter and escape through feminine pronouns.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the suffixes in {{ar:مُوَاقِعُوهَا}} ({{tr:muwāqi'ūhā}}) and {{ar:عَنْهَا}} ({{tr:'anhā}}) back to the fire.

topics.headline: first beat closes on the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first clause comes to rest on the fire before cognition begins.
topics.reason: The full VSO clause completes before the result particle, making the object the visual endpoint of the opening beat.

words.gloss_range: result particle marking immediate consequence from seeing to cognition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: seen object that triggers the result clause
cognition verb introduced by the result particle

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the ayah's first hinge. It turns the sight of {{ar:ٱلنَّارَ}} ({{tr:an-nāra}}) into the immediate cause of {{ar:ظَنُّوا}} ({{tr:ẓannū}}), so the middle clause is not a loose second report but cognition produced by vision.

topics.headline: immediate causal hinge from sight to certainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that seeing the fire directly generates the certainty clause.
topics.reason: The particle links the completed seeing clause to {{ar:ظَنُّوا}} ({{tr:ẓannū}}) as both sequence and consequence.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural cognition verb completed by an assertive content clause; locally tilted from supposition toward certainty
words.root_gloss_range: root range can include conjecture and certainty; the following assertive clause selects recognition under pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: assertive content-clause opener governed by the cognition verb
predicate naming the recognized fire encounter

words.prose: {{ar:ظَنُّوا}} ({{tr:ẓannū}}) carries the same criminals into a completed cognitive reaction. The root can move between supposition and certainty, but {{ar:أَنَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:annahum}}) makes the content assertive, so the local effect is compelled recognition: they now know themselves to be {{ar:مُوَاقِعُوهَا}} ({{tr:muwāqi'ūhā}}). This reverses the garden-owner's earlier confidence in his own suppositions (18:35; 18:36), and it joins a wider cognition-and-falling frame also visible at 7:171.

topics.headline: completed inner consequence of seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah moves inward after sight before closing with failed action.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect 3mp and governs the {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) clause as its complement.

topics.headline: supposition range forced toward certainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the mental reversal from possible uncertainty into unavoidable recognition.
topics.reason: The root range includes conjecture, but {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) and the sight trigger narrow the local force toward certainty.

topics.headline: garden supposition answered by judgment certainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earlier human miscalculation is answered by compelled recognition (18:35; 18:36).
topics.reason: The same-surah CRITICAL rows give the concrete references where confident supposition is reversed.

topics.headline: cognition aimed at falling encounter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their recognition has an event-shape: falling into encounter with the fire, contrasted with 7:171.
topics.reason: The local complement is {{ar:مُوَاقِعُوهَا}} ({{tr:muwāqi'ūhā}}), and the CRITICAL rows specify the 7:171 directional contrast.

words.gloss_range: assertive particle plus plural pronoun, introducing the content clause and making the criminals its embedded subject

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: embedded plural subject inside the assertive particle

words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:annahum}}) turns the cognitive verb into a full asserted proposition. The suffix {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) carries the criminals inside the clause as its subject, and the following active participle makes their fire-encounter a recognized state rather than a detached event report.

topics.headline: assertive scope after cognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices why the cognition reads as recognized truth rather than loose fear.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the complement of {{ar:ظَنُّوا}} ({{tr:ẓannū}}) and scopes over the predicate.

topics.headline: same criminals embedded inside the proposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the subject they recognize is themselves, held in a nominal state of encounter.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) the subject of the embedded clause with {{ar:مُوَاقِعُوهَا}} ({{tr:muwāqi'ūhā}}) as predicate.

words.gloss_range: Form III active participle predicate with plural agreement and a fire-pronoun object; falling into or encountering the fire as an impending state
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes falling, occurring, impact, encounter, and realized event; local Form III participle selects fire-encounter with contact pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: assertive particle that hosts the predicate clause
plural subject with which the predicate agrees
object suffix referring to the fire

words.prose: {{ar:مُوَاقِعُوهَا}} ({{tr:muwāqi'ūhā}}) is the predicate of the {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) clause, agreeing with {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) and attaching the fire through {{ar:هَا}} ({{tr:hā}}). The word makes their fate a standing state of falling-encounter, not merely a completed fall. Form III makes the encounter feel bilateral: they fall into the fire, and the fire meets them in contact, so the image is collision rather than distant approach. Variant and root-family rows widen the encounter geometry to meeting and envelopment, while local grammar keeps the selected wording as impactful encounter with the fire; the 7:171 parallel reverses the direction from a thing falling on people to these people falling into fire.

topics.headline: predicate makes the fire their target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recognized fate is grammatically tied to the same fire already seen.
topics.reason: The active participle is the predicate of {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}), agrees with {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}), and takes {{ar:هَا}} ({{tr:hā}}) as the fire object.

topics.headline: falling encounter with total contact pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fire-encounter is not distant approach but contact, impact, and being received by the destination.
topics.reason: Root-family contact and Form III pressure survive, while sexual or over-specific contact senses are secondary images rather than the local denotation.

topics.headline: recognized event becomes factual
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their cognition is aimed at a real event taking shape, not an imagined possibility.
topics.reason: The local clause joins {{ar:ظَنُّوا}} ({{tr:ẓannū}}) to an occurrence-root predicate inside an assertive complement.

topics.headline: falling frame reversed and intensified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fire encounter answers both the prior boundary scene and the reversed falling construction at 7:171.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete references and the local predication supports the directional contrast.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction opening the final negated finding clause as a parallel conclusion
words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the failed-finding clause with the certainty clause. It opens a distinct final panel: after they know the encounter, they also do not find a way away from the fire.

topics.headline: certainty joined to failed escape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no escape is a second coordinated conclusion, not a subordinate afterthought.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces {{ar:لَمْ يَجِدُوا}} ({{tr:lam yajidū}}) as a coordinated clause after the asserted encounter.

words.gloss_range: jussive negator converting the following imperfect into completed denial over the whole escape-finding clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: jussive finding verb governed by negation
whole escape-finding phrase under negation

words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) governs {{ar:يَجِدُوا}} ({{tr:yajidū}}) and closes the possibility of finding. Its scope covers the full phrase {{ar:يَجِدُوا عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًا}} ({{tr:yajidū 'anhā maṣrifan}}): not just a verb is denied, but the whole possibility of finding any turning-away point from the fire.

topics.headline: completed negation over the escape search
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the search is grammatically closed as failed, not left open as an ongoing attempt.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:يَجِدُوا}} ({{tr:yajidū}}) as jussive under {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}), and attachment evidence scopes the negation over the final clause.

words.gloss_range: imperfect jussive finding verb under negation, with the escape noun as explicit object and the criminals as implicit plural subject
words.root_gloss_range: finding field can include discovery, experience, and available means; local negation denies attainable escape rather than merely reporting emotion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negating particle governing the finding verb
explicit object denied to the finding verb
same-root contrast from the earlier garden-owner boast in 18:36

words.prose: {{ar:يَجِدُوا}} ({{tr:yajidū}}) is jussive under {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) and takes {{ar:مَصْرِفًا}} ({{tr:maṣrifan}}) as its object. The same criminals remain present only through the plural ending, so the ayah compresses them into the final action: those who saw and recognized now fail to find. The finding field reaches beyond locating an exit into available capacity, but local grammar narrows it to the denied discovery of any usable turning-away means; this answers the garden-owner's confident {{ar:لَأَجِدَنَّ}} ({{tr:la-ajidanna}}) in 18:36 with collective failure.

topics.headline: transitive finding denied under jussive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the missing thing is explicit: a findable escape-means is denied.
topics.reason: The verb is governed by {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) and has {{ar:مَصْرِفًا}} ({{tr:maṣrifan}}) as direct object.

topics.headline: no available reality or capacity for escape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that negated finding implies no available escape-reality, not merely unsuccessful looking.
topics.reason: The broader finding and existence field survives as pressure, while the local object keeps the claim tied to escape-means.

topics.headline: third beat closes with failed action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah completes a chain from seeing to recognition to practical inability.
topics.reason: The verb is coordinated with {{ar:ظَنُّوا}} ({{tr:ẓannū}}) and retains the same subject through pro-drop agreement.

topics.headline: confident finding reversed in the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the boast of finding better in 18:36 is answered by failure to find escape.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows identify the concrete same-surah verbal reversal and no guardrail evidence blocks it.

words.gloss_range: preposition of separation plus feminine pronoun referring to the fire, placed before the missing escape noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: antecedent of the feminine suffix
preposition selecting separation in this phrase
missing turning-away means completed by the prepositional phrase

words.prose: {{ar:عَنْهَا}} ({{tr:'anhā}}) fixes the direction of the final failure before the object is named. The pronoun points back to {{ar:ٱلنَّارَ}} ({{tr:an-nāra}}), and {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:'an}}) is narrowed here to separation: the sought {{ar:مَصْرِفًا}} ({{tr:maṣrifan}}) would have to turn them away from it.

topics.headline: separation from the fire leads the final phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that direction away from the fire is introduced before the missing means is named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves {{ar:هَا}} ({{tr:hā}}) to the fire and links the prepositional phrase to {{ar:مَصْرِفًا}} ({{tr:maṣrifan}}) as turning away from it.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative noun of place, means, or time of turning; the final denied escape-pivot
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes turning, diverting, changing, and exchange; local mafʿil noun selects a place or means of turning away from the fire

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negation under which the indefinite escape noun is denied

words.prose: {{ar:مَصْرِفًا}} ({{tr:maṣrifan}}) is the named object that cannot be found. Its noun pattern makes the missing item a place, means, or moment of turning, and its indefiniteness under {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) denies any instance at all. The final word gives escape a concrete pivot-image and then removes it: no route, instrument, conversion, or point of diversion remains. Its rare form and final position prepare the immediate return of the same turning root in 18:54, while other references contrast failed self-turning here with divine turning (3:152; 7:146).

topics.headline: no instance of an escape-means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices exactly what is absent: any place or means by which turning away could begin.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as object of {{ar:يَجِدُوا}} ({{tr:yajidū}}), indefinite, and morphologically a place-or-means noun.

topics.headline: turning and conversion pivot denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that escape is imagined as a trajectory-changing pivot, not only a door or path.
topics.reason: The turning, diversion, and exchange fields survive as local pressure, but modern banking language is only a narrowed analogy for conversion, not the local sense.

topics.headline: rare final word concentrates closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes on a rare noun for the missing pivot, making failed escape the final impression.
topics.reason: The form is marked as unique in the supplied rows and stands as the ayah's final word after {{ar:عَنْهَا}} ({{tr:'anhā}}).

topics.headline: failed self-turning opens root transition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denied self-turning here contrasts with divine turning elsewhere and leads into the next ayah root recurrence (18:54).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete references for divine turning and immediate recurrence, and the local clause supports the contrast.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence رَءَا ... ٱلنَّارَ فَظَنُّوا أَنَّهُم مُّوَاقِعُوهَا ... مَصْرِفًا moves from sight through judgment to unavoidable contact and failed redirection.
baseline_models.mechanism: Direct perception supplies an indication strong enough to settle ظن as certainty; that certainty projects a fall or encounter whose occurrence is fixed, and the final failed search closes the only remaining directional possibility.

activation_trace.role: Eye or inward perception supplies the direct detection that starts the closure sequence.
The kindled fire supplies the concrete and visibly active object of perception.
Certainty reached after an indication converts seeing into settled expectation.
Falling into a place and the fixing of an occurrence supply unavoidable contact.
Finding or reaching a sought thing frames escape as an attempted search that fails.
Turning something away from a direction supplies the absent outlet and completes the lock.

changed_reading.before: The criminals see the Fire, expect to enter it, and cannot escape.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is a staged epistemic lock: visible evidence becomes certainty, certainty becomes fixed contact, and search discovers that no directional remainder is left.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ and وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا ... مَصْرِفًا place acquired culpability beside the failure of capacity and maneuver.
baseline_models.mechanism: The agents named by guilt and acquisition reach a state in which neither available means nor tactical alteration can operate. The negation therefore removes agency, not merely a physical doorway.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition and earning supply the agents' accumulated side of the causal relation.
Offense and culpability specify what kind of acquisition defines the agents.
Capacity, means, and sufficiency supply the operational resource denied by the clause.
Maneuver and tactical alteration supply the agency that can no longer change the outcome.

changed_reading.before: They cannot locate a place away from the Fire.
changed_reading.after: Those marked by what they acquired discover that no capacity or maneuver remains with which to alter the state now confronting them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The water-plant image is a transport and phase-change system: descent, mixing, drying into fragments, and wind dispersal. Against that field of mobile matter, the focus ayah marks a terminal state in which neither transport nor transformation can redirect the criminals from the Fire.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary water supplies the mobile medium from which the transformation sequence begins.
Descent and settling supply the first directed movement through the material system.
Mixing one thing with another supplies a change of material relation and state.
Dry broken vegetation supplies the fragmentable phase that can be carried elsewhere.
Wind-winnowing and airborne dispersal supply successful removal from an initial place.
Wind and moving air supply the carrier that executes dispersal.
Transfer from one condition to another supplies the transformation that the negated maṣrif now denies.

structural_cues: 18:45 orders descent, mixing, growth, dry fragmentation, and wind dispersal; 18:53 ends with a negated maṣrif.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of material transformations and a final denial of redirection; I treat dispersal as the available routing pole opposed by maṣrif. A live alternative is that 18:45 contributes only ephemerality, not a transport analogy.

changed_reading.before: No escape route can be found.
changed_reading.after: The Fire is the terminal boundary of a pericope full of mobile, transformable matter: here no carrier, fragmentation, or change of state produces removal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exposure, gathering, inscription, and exhaustive counting construct a complete inventory. The repeated finding construction then yields an asymmetry: every deed is found present, while no diversion is found available.

activation_trace.role: Visible exposure supplies an environment in which concealment has been removed.
Driving and gathering a group to one destination supplies complete subject collection.
An inscription that establishes an obligating judgment supplies the durable record.
Counting by exhaustive enumeration supplies the record's total coverage.
Finding the sought or encountered thing supplies the positive discovery of the deeds.
Intentional action supplies what the inventory returns to its agents.
Presence, witnessing, and proximity make the recorded actions immediately available.
The same finding image, now negated, supplies the absent side of the inventory.
A means of turning away supplies the one item the exhaustive scene does not contain.

structural_cues: The same criminal group appears in 18:49 and 18:53.
18:49 says they found what they had done present; 18:53 says they did not find a diversion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated agents, repeated finding, and exhaustive presence; I infer a deliberately asymmetric inventory in which evidence exists but exit does not. The live alternative is simple scene succession without a designed inventory contrast.

changed_reading.before: The criminals happen upon an inescapable punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their encounter is the output of an audit architecture: persons and deeds are exhaustively present, while the search for an exculpatory or spatial exit returns empty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adopted allies and partners constitute an attempted substitute-support network. The sequence denies helper status, withholds their answer, and replaces connection with a separating trap; the absent maṣrif is therefore social and relational as well as spatial.

activation_trace.role: Alliance, love, and aid supply the expected protective relation.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the attempted substitution.
A strengthening helper supplies the support role explicitly denied to the misleaders.
Partnership supplies the distributed agency on which the callers had relied.
A returned answer supplies the responsive link whose failure disables the network.
Distance and a widened gap replace the expected closeness of partnership.
Entrapment from which one cannot disengage supplies the relational network's terminal form.
Turning harm away supplies the protective function that no ally or partner performs.

structural_cues: 18:50-52 move from adopted allies and a bad substitute to denied helper status, unanswered partners, and a trap placed between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitute relations, expected aid, failed response, separation, and entrapment; I infer that these actors were also imagined as channels for diverted consequence. Alternatively, their failure may expose false worship without directly functioning as an escape mechanism.

changed_reading.before: No route leads away from the Fire.
changed_reading.after: No outsourced agency remains: every substitute, helper, partner, and responsive link has failed, so consequence cannot be routed through another actor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact ص ر ف repetition creates a hinge. Revelation had transferred its address through many exemplary forms, but disputation met that multiplicity; the focus maṣrif is the exhausted opposite, where no further turn can alter the destination.

activation_trace.role: Transferring discourse from form to form supplies the many offered interpretive turnings.
The presented example supplies the repeated forms through which warning was made available.
Twisted contention supplies the human response that consumes variation without yielding redirection.
Turning away from a direction supplies the final possibility that is now absent.

structural_cues: Immediate adjacency pairs the negated noun maṣrif in 18:53 with the positive causative verb ṣarrafnā in 18:54.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact root repetition, varied examples, and disputation; I infer a temporal-ethical contrast between abundant pre-judgment rerouting and absent post-sight rerouting. The repetition could instead be noncausal verbal resonance.

changed_reading.before: At punishment there is no way to turn aside.
changed_reading.after: The missing final turn is set against many earlier communicative turnings: the ayah closes a capacity that revelation had repeatedly opened before certainty arrived.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance and warning are met by dislodging argument, turning away, coverings, and auditory weight. Punishment then stands face-to-face, so the focus sight is not ordinary information but perception restored only when it can no longer support a change of direction.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a path and truth supplies the earlier directional opportunity.
Face-to-face confrontation supplies the eventual mode in which punishment becomes directly perceptible.
Warning that awakens caution supplies information intended to enable action before encounter.
Removing something from its place supplies the attempted argumentative displacement of truth.
Turning one's side away supplies the chosen directional refusal.
A protective covering supplies the obstruction of inward reception.
Weight in the ear supplies the obstruction of warning by hearing.
Direct sight supplies the perception that finally penetrates all prior obstruction.
Certainty after a visible indication supplies cognition that is now decisive but no longer preventive.

structural_cues: 18:55-57 pair arriving guidance and warning with turning away, coverings, and deafness; 18:53 pairs direct sight with certainty and no turning place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earlier directional and perceptual refusal followed by direct sight; I infer that moral refusal hardens into final spatial inability. A live alternative is that the coverings are imposed consequence rather than a self-produced causal trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Seeing the Fire makes the criminals realize that encounter is unavoidable.
changed_reading.after: Sight is tragically late: perception becomes certain only after the earlier perceptual and directional capacities that could have changed the course have been refused or blocked.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy explains non-hastening, while appointment fixes a later limit. The near-parallel failed-finding clauses equate the focus maṣrif with the later absent refuge: delay opens time before reckoning but does not create an alternate destination after it.

activation_trace.role: Merciful tenderness supplies the reason immediate seizure is withheld.
Seeking and acquiring an outcome supplies the deeds for which seizure could occur.
Acceleration and bringing forward supply the timing explicitly withheld.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the deferred but bounded terminus.

branches.source_phrase_ar: جرم أي كسب لأن الذي يحوزه فكأنه اقتطعه؛ فلان جريمة أهله أي كاسبهم؛ جرمت فزارة أي كسبتهم غضبا (maqayis)؛ جرم يجرم أي كسب؛ فلان جريمة أهله أي كاسبهم؛ ولا يجرمنكم أي لا يحملنكم ويقال لا يكسبنكم (sihah)؛ خرج يجرم قومه أي يكسبهم؛ لا يحملنكم ولا يكسبنكم؛ أجرمني كذا وجرمني وجرمت وأجرمت بمعنى واحد (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi suçu veya günahı, bu fiili işlemeyi ve fiilin faili olan suçlu kişiyi aynı anlam alanında açıkça birleştirir. Kötü bir şey kazanma açıklaması tarihsel-semanti̇k bağlantı sağlar, fakat dalın güncel çekirdeği nötr kazanma değil, yanlış fiil ve onun sorumluluğudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal suç ve günah alanını kapsar; belirli bir kalıba ait ek anlam tanımın çekirdeğine taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Hukuki veya ahlaki bakımdan yanlış sayılan bir fiil, günah ya da haksızlıktır; aynı aile bu fiili işlemeyi ve işleyen suçlu kişiyi de belirtir.

facets.statement: Suç, günah, haksızlık veya kötü sonuç doğuran yanlış fiildir.
Yanlış fiili işleme ve böylece suçlu duruma girme eylemini kapsar.
Suçu veya haksızlığı işleyen fail, suçlu ya da günahkar kişi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt suçu, günahı ve haksız fiili; bunları işlemeyi ve faili adlandıran biçimleri birlikte verir. Anlamın kazanma dalıyla ilişkisi, kötü fiilin kişi tarafından kazanılmış sayılması üzerinden açıklanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yanlış fiilin kendisini ve kişinin bu fiili gerçekleştirerek sorumlu olmasını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yanlış fiili, işlenmesini ve failin sorumluluğunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Fiilin hukuki veya toplumsal bakımdan yanlış sayıldığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yanlış fiil ve bu fiile bağlanan sorumluluk çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yanlışlığın özellikle ahlaki veya dinsel sorumluluk olarak sunulduğu bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ahlaki yanlışlığı ve kişinin bu fiili gerçekleştirmesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yanlış fiil ve sorumluluk çekirdeğine sahiptir; komşu dalın çekirdeği nötr kazanma ve elde etmedir, suç ancak kazanılan şey kötü olduğunda ortaya çıkar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجرم والجريمة بمعنى الذنب، والإجرام، والمجرم، والجارم الجاني أو المذنب، والتعدي حيث نص عليه التهذيب
branches.source_phrase_ar: فلان له جريمة أي جرم وهو مصدر الجارم الذي يجرم على نفسه وقومه شرا؛ الجرم الذنب وفعله الإجرام والمجرم المذنب والجارم الجاني (ayn)؛ الجرم الذنب والجريمة مثله؛ جرم وأجرم واجترم بمعنى (sihah)؛ الجرم مصدر الجارم؛ الجارم الجاني والمجرم والمذنب؛ لا يدخلنكم في الجرم؛ الجرم التعدي والجرم الذنب (tahdhib)؛ الجرم والجريمة الذنب وهو من الأول لأنه كسب (maqayis)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه لا جرم في معنى لا بد ولا محالة أو حقا، وما اتصل بها من معنى القسم أو تحقيق الخبر في كلام المصادر
يدخل فيه الحول أو السنة أو الشهر أو اليوم المجرم بمعنى التام، وتجرم السنة أو الليل بمعنى مضى وذهب وانقضى، وخرجنا من السنة
يدخل فيه الجرم بمعنى الجسد أو البدن أو ألواح الجسد وجثمانه، والجريم والجريمة لذي الجسم، وعظم الأجرام
يدخل فيه جرم الصوت بمعنى جهارته أو خروجه من الجرم، وما روي من إطلاق الجرم على الصوت مع تحفظ بعض المصادر
يدخل فيه الجرم بمعنى اللون، وجرم لونه إذا صفا كما في التهذيب
يدخل فيه أرض جرم، والجرم بمعنى الحر، والجروم من البلاد خلاف الصرود، مع كون المصادر تصرح بدخالة اللفظ أو تعريبه
يدخل فيه جرم اسما لقبيلة أو بطنين من العرب، وبنو جارم علما لقوم من العرب

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yanan ateşi, bu adın ışık ve hızlı hareketle bağlantısını ve hayvanın ateşle yapılan damgasını birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve bu çok parçalı yapıyı doğru yansıtır; damga kullanımı ateşin temel tanımına değil, ona bağlı ayrı bir kullanıma yerleştirilmelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ateş anlamı ile hayvana ait damga ve atasözü yapıları ayrı tutulur; özel yapılar genel ateş anlamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yanarak ışık ve ısı yayan, hareketli alevleri bulunan ateşi anlatır. Aynı dalda, hayvana ateşle yakılarak yapılan damgaya ve bu damga üzerinden kurulan bir söze bağlı özel kullanımlar da vardır.

facets.statement: Işık veren ve hızlı, kararsız hareket gösteren yanan ateş temel anlamdır.
Hayvan üzerinde ateşle yakılarak oluşturulan damga, ateş çekirdeğine bağlı özel anlamdır.
Hayvanın soyu ile damgasını ilişkilendiren söz, damga anlamına bağlı kalıplaşmış kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yanan ateşi ışık ve hareket niteliğiyle açıklar; çoğul biçimlerini ve hayvanın ateşle yapılan damgasına bağlı kullanımları da aynı dalda toplar.

concept_gloss.text: yanan ateş ve ateşle yapılan hayvan damgası

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النار وما سميت به لطريقة الإضاءة واضطراب الحركة، وجموعها، والسمة بالنار في الناقة والإبل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: النار مؤنثة وهي من الواو؛ الجمع نور ونيران (sihah)؛ ما نار هذه الناقة أي ما سمتها؛ نجارها نارها؛ سماتها (sihah)؛ النور والنار سميا بذلك من طريقة الإضاءة ولأن ذلك يكون مضطربا سريع الحركة (maqayis)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تنورت النار إذا قصدت إليها أو تبصرتها من بعد.
يدخل فيه نور الشجر ونواره، وتنوير الشجرة أو إنارتها بمعنى إزهارها وإخراج نورها.
يدخل فيه المنار علامة الطريق، ومنار الأرض حدودها وأعلامها، والمنارة التي يهتدى بها أو يوضع عليها السراج أو يؤذن عليها.
يدخل فيه نوار للمرأة العفيفة النافرة من القبيح أو الرجال، والنور أو النوار في الظباء والنساء والفرس والبقرة النافرة، ونرت فلانا إذا أنفرته.
يدخل فيه النائرة الواقعة بين القوم بمعنى العداوة والشحناء.
يدخل فيه النُّؤور أو النُّوور، وهو دخان الفتيلة أو الشحم المتخذ كحلا أو وشما، ويدخل فيه نور العضو إذا غرز ثم ذر عليه الإثمد أو النُّوور.
يدخل فيه النُّورَة التي يطلى بها، وتنور الرجل إذا تطلى بالنُّورَة.
يدخل فيه قولهم نور على فلان إذا شبه عليه أمرا.
يدخل فيه النِّير في أخدود الطريق الواضح، وعلم الثوب، والخشبة على عنق الفدان، وما قيس على الوضوح والبروز في مدخل نير.

root_profile.summary: Kök alanı ışık ve ateş çevresindeki merkezden ağaç çiçeği, yol işareti, ürkme, topluluklar arası düşmanlık, boya amaçlı duman karası, bedene sürülen karışım ve yanıltma gibi uzak anlamlara yayılır. identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem kesin bilme yerine geçen kullanımı hem de bir belirtiden doğup güçlendikçe bilgiye ulaşan inanışı birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dal, baştan beri koşulsuz kesinlik değil, güçlü kanıtla kesin bilgi düzeyine varan zihinsel tutum olarak sınırlandırılmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin düşüp belirli bir yerde gerçekleşmesini temel alır; sözün veya hükmün zorunlu hale gelmesi ise belirli bir kullanımda ortaya çıkan uzantıdır. root_profile.summary: Kök, değer yüceliği, iyi yazgı, kesme, yenilik, çizgi ve yol, kıyı, düz yer, kararlı çaba, üst kuşak yakınları, otlak kuyusu, su veya süt yoksunluğu, dolaşık parçalar, bir böcek ve yer adları gibi birbirinden belirgin biçimde ayrılan anlam dalları taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi ya da kişiyi bulunduğu yön veya durumdan geri çevirme, başka bir duruma aktarma ve zararı uzaklaştırma çekirdeğini açıkça destekler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalı karşılar; öteki dallara özgü kalıplaşmış kullanımlar buraya taşınmamıştır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi ya da kişiyi yöneldiği yerden veya bulunduğu durumdan geri çevirmek, başka bir yöne ya da duruma geçirmek; böylece bir zarar veya cezayı da sahibinden uzaklaştırabilmek.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir varlığın yönünü veya durumunu geri çevirme ya da başka yöne aktarmadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar geri çevirme, yön değiştirtme, bir durumdan başka duruma geçirme ve zararı uzaklaştırma anlatımlarını aynı çekirdekte toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi ya da şeyin yönü veya durumu değiştirildiğinde ve zarar uzaklaştırıldığında genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Geri çevirme, yön ya da durum değiştirme ve uzaklaştırma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Zararın, sıkıntının veya cezanın bir kimseden giderilmesi bağlamında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyin hedef kişiden öteye çevrilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel yön ve durum değiştirme kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal doğrudan bir şeyden geri çevirme üzerinde dururken odak dal yön ve durum aktarımını ve zararın uzaklaştırılmasını da kapsar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رد الشيء أو الشخص عن جهة أو حالة، والانصراف، وصرف الأذى أو العذاب عن صاحبه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: معظم بابه يدل على رجع الشيء؛ صرفت القوم صرفا وانصرفوا إذا رجعتهم فرجعوا (maqayis)؛ الصرف أن تصرف إنسانا على وجه يريده إلى مصرف غير ذلك (ayn;tahdhib)؛ صرفت الرجل عني فانصرف؛ صرف الله عنك الأذى (sihah)؛ رد الشيء من حالة إلى حالة أو إبداله بغيره (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi tekrar tekrar yön ve durumdan duruma çevirme çekirdeğini; rüzgar, olay, bildirim ve söz biçimi gibi özel uygulamalarla birlikte destekler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel çoklu dönüştürmeyi verir; rüzgar, bildirim ve sözcük kullanımları ayrıca yapıya bağlı özel yüzlerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi tek bir dönüşle bırakmayıp çeşitli yönlere, durumlara veya biçimlere geçirmek ve işletmek. Belirli yapılarda bu, bildirimleri değişik yönleriyle açıklama ya da bir sözcüğü dil bilgisel biçimlere sokma olur.

facets.statement: Bir varlığı çeşitli yönler, durumlar veya biçimler arasında tekrar tekrar değiştirmek temel anlamdır.
Bildirimleri açıklamak ve sözcüğü dil bilgisel biçimlere sokmak, belirli yapılara bağlı uzmanlaşmış kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çokluk ve yineleme taşıyan yön ya da durum değişimini ortaklaştırır; rüzgarların çevrilmesi, bildirimlerin açıklanması ve sözcüğün işletilmesi bunun özel uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin birden çok yönde, durumda veya biçimde işletildiği genel dönüşüm bağlamına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çoklu yön, durum ve biçim değişikliği çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bildirimlerin farklı anlatım yönleriyle açıklanıp yinelendiği özel yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Aynı içeriğin farklı yönler üzerinden işletilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Fiziksel yön ve durum değişikliklerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sözcüğün dil bilgisel biçimlere sokulması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sözcüğün biçimsel olarak işletilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Dil dışındaki bütün yön ve durum değiştirme kapsamını bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyi bir yönden veya durumdan başka birine geçirmeyi anlatır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تصريف الرياح والسيول والخيول والأمور والآيات والكلام والكلمة، أي نقلها أو إجراؤها من وجه إلى وجه ومن حال إلى حال.
branches.source_phrase_ar: تصريف الرياح تصرفها من وجه إلى وجه وحال إلى حال وكذلك تصريف الخيول والسيول والأمور (ayn)؛ تصريف الآيات تبيينها (tahdhib)؛ التصريف كالصرف إلا في التكثير وأكثر ما يقال في صرف الشيء من حالة إلى حالة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi işlerde kıvrakça yol bulma, çare kullanma, deneyimle hareket etme ve geçim için çalışıp kazanma yüzlerini açıkça bir araya getirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal pratik çare ve işlerde kıvraklık olarak tanımlanmış, para değiştirme anlamı eklenmemiştir.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi değişen koşullara göre kıvrakça yürütmek, çare bulup uygulamak ve deneyimle sonuç almaya çalışmak; bunun bir uygulaması geçim için kazanç sağlamaktır.

facets.statement: İşlerde çare kullanarak kıvrak, deneyimli ve uyarlanabilir biçimde hareket etmek temel anlamdır.
Aile geçimini sağlamak için çalışıp kazanmak, pratik iş yürütmenin özel bir uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çare, işlerde kıvrak hareket ve deneyimi ortaklaştırır; geçim için kazanç arama da bu pratik hareket alanına bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Değişen bir işi deneyim ve pratik yollarla yürütme anlamının genel karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Çare kullanma, uyarlanma ve işi deneyimle yürütme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aile için geçim sağlamaya yönelik çalışma ve kazanç bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Pratik hareketin kazanç sağlamaya dönük sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Kazanç dışındaki çare ve iş yürütme kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Deneyimli kıvraklık ve aile için kazanç sağlama uzantısı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Güç, imkan ve bir işi deneme yönü daha geniş biçimde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir işi çarelere başvurarak yürütmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal değişen işlerdeki kıvraklık ve deneyimi, ayrıca geçim kazanmayı vurgular; komşu dal çare yanında güç ve girişim alanını da kapsar.

branches.source_phrase_ar: صيرفيات الأمور متصرفاتها أي تتقلب بالناس (ayn)؛ الصرف الحيلة؛ الصيرف المحتال المتصرف في الأمور (sihah)؛ الصرف التقلب والحيلة؛ يصطرف لعياله أي يكتسب لهم؛ الصيرف والصيرفي المحتال المتقلب في أموره المجرب لها (tahdhib)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصرف في عبارة لا يقبل منه صرف ولا عدل، وما فسر بالتوبة أو النافلة أو الحيلة، وكذلك صرفا بمعنى وسيلة دفع أو تحويل في مقابلة النصر.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi altın, gümüş ve basılı paraların birbirine çevrilmesini; ayrıca iki para arasındaki değer veya ayar farkını ve bu işi yapan kişiyi açıkça destekler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal parasal değişim ve fark anlamında tanımlanmış, genel nesne değiş tokuşuna genişletilmemiştir.

concept_map.definition: Altın, gümüş veya basılı parayı başka tür paraya çevirmek ve iki para arasında değer ya da metal niteliğinden doğan farkı belirtmek.

facets.statement: Bir para türünü başka bir para türüyle değiştirmek temel işlemdir.
İki para arasındaki değer veya metal niteliği farkı, değişim işlemine bağlı bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar değerli metal ve basılı paraların birbirine çevrilmesini, aralarındaki değer ya da nitelik farkını ve bu işi yapan kişiyi birlikte kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Para türlerinin birbirine çevrilmesi ve aralarındaki parasal ya da metal niteliği farkı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem para değişimi işlemini hem paralar arasındaki farkı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir para türünün başka tür veya birim paraya çevrildiği işlem bağlamında doğaldır.

error_profile.loses: Paralar arasındaki değer veya ayar farkını adlandırmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Her tür malın karşılık veya benzerle değişimini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyi karşılığında başka bir şeyle değiştirme alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız para ve değer farkına ilişkindir; komşu dal ise mallar arasında daha genel bir karşılıklı değişimi ve eşdeğerliği anlatır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بيع الذهب بالفضة، وصرف الدراهم بالدنانير، وفضل الدرهم على الدرهم في القيمة أو جودة الفضة، واسم الصيرفي والصراف.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الصرف فضل الدرهم على الدرهم في القيمة؛ الدينار صرف إلى الدراهم؛ الصيرفي لتصريفه أحدهما إلى الآخر (maqayis)؛ الصرف فضل الدرهم في القيمة وجودة الفضة وبيع الذهب بالفضة (ayn)؛ صرفت الدراهم بالدنانير؛ بين الدرهمين صرف (sihah)؛ صرف الدراهم؛ الصرف الفضل (tahdhib)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه صرف الحديث أو الكلام بمعنى تزيينه والزيادة فيه حتى تميل الأسماع أو القلوب إليه، وفضل بعض الكلام على بعض.
يدخل فيه حدث الدهر ونوائبه وصروفه، وما يتقلب بالناس من أمور الزمان، والصرفان إذا أريد بهما الليل والنهار.
يدخل فيه الصرفة اسما لمنزل أو كوكب، وتسميتها بانصراف البرد أو إقبال الحر، وقولهم ناب الدهر.
يدخل فيه الصرفة خرزة أو أخذ يزعم به صرف قلب الرجل عما يريد.
يدخل فيه الصراف أو الصرافة للشاء والبقر والكلاب والسباع إذا اشتهت الفحل، وناقة أو كلبة أو عنز صارف.
يدخل فيه صريف ناب البعير، وصريف البكرة، وصريف الباب، وما أشبهه من صوت يرده الاحتكاك أو الدوران.

branches.branch_image_ar: صريف لبن أو خمر مأخوذ لساعته
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصريف للبن ساعة يحلب أو حين تنصرف عنه الرغوة، والصريف أو الصريفية للخمر الطيبة المأخوذة من دنها لساعتها.
يدخل فيه شراب صرف غير ممزوج، وكل شيء خالص لا خلط فيه، والصرف صبغ أحمر أو لون الأديم الخالص الشديد الحمرة.
